chrome-devtools.description: ADR-0038 (Issue #174). A browser for product-lead's read-only sweep, bounded by origin. The shell reads HARNESS_SWEEP_ORIGIN when the server starts, from the environment the harness gives it, which carries the project's settings env. With no value, or one that does not begin http:// or https://, the origin is the discard port, so the browser reaches nothing. The package is pinned to one exact version and fetched with install scripts off.
args: o=$HARNESS_SWEEP_ORIGIN; case "$o" in http://*|https://*) ;; *) o='http://127.0.0.1:9/*' ;; esac; exec npx --ignore-scripts -y chrome-devtools-mcp@1.8.0 --isolated --channel stable --viewport 1280x800 --no-usage-statistics --no-performance-crux --allowedUrlPattern "$o"
